openapi.mutability: The live first-party document is mutable. Generation verifies byte length, SHA-256, OpenAPI identity, server, explicit operation auth, deprecations, media, success shapes, and pagination before writing any artifact.
evidence: 190 operations across 152 paths; 178 active and 12 deprecated
exact server https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1 and explicit APIToken Bearer security on every operation
exact parameters, required JSON bodies, JSON-or-empty success responses, and repeated-array serialization
38 exact page/per_page loops with meta.pagination.next_page evidence
project-scoped API token authority and 50-record page maximum in the embedded first-party guide
openapi.title: Hetzner Cloud API

pagination.response_evidence: meta.pagination.next_page is integer|null on every automatic route

auth.selected: Project-scoped Hetzner Cloud API token resolved only by the trusted Bearer connection adapter
auth.origin_matching: fixed https://api.hetzner.cloud origin; per_org and caller-controlled host selection are deliberately disabled

authority_notes.standalone_id_scoped_action_lookup: GET /actions requires query.id and is not an all-actions feed

source_decision.reason: Hetzner servers, networks, volumes, zones, and asynchronous actions are infrastructure control-plane resources rather than user-work tasks, notes, or projects. No honest canonical work projection is claimed.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The official server URL includes /v1, while a leading-slash runtime path would discard that prefix if the prefixed URL were used as the HTTP base.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses the origin-only https://api.hetzner.cloud base, emits /v1 on every wire path, and declares openapi_source.path_alias.wire_prefix=/v1 so documentary proof remains exact.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Every operation carries APIToken Bearer authority, and each API token is bound to one Hetzner Cloud project with potentially broad infrastructure access.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Pins the exact origin, verifies explicit operation security across all 189 routes, keeps the token inside one encrypted project-scoped connection, and exposes no credential argument.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Five server operations return one-time root, rescue, rebuild, reset, VNC, or capability-bearing console credentials.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps the operations complete but labels the exact response fields secret, classifies the mutations destructive, requires approval, and excludes every credential route from bundled workflows.

audit_findings_folded.finding: All 107 active mutations can incur cost or alter availability, network reachability, firewall policy, storage, certificates, DNS, or protection state.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Classifies every POST, PUT, and DELETE as destructive, marks PUT and DELETE idempotent only where their HTTP contract supports it, requires approval every run, and configures no hidden retry.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Required JSON bodies can contain cloud-init user data, private certificate keys, firewall rules, network topology, credentials, and complete DNS record sets.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses bounded required body_raw strings for all 76 body operations so nested values, explicit nulls, and exact integer lexemes survive without widening credentials into named pack arguments.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The live first-party OpenAPI is mutable and its current document already includes 2026 DNS additions and deprecations.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Pins exact bytes and SHA-256 and fails before writing on identity, path, operation, auth, media, body, deprecation, or pagination drift.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Twelve operations are provider-deprecated, including both Data Center endpoints and ten resource-scoped single-action detail aliases.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excludes exactly those twelve operations, records their operation IDs and paths, retains active Locations and aggregate/resource action routes, and never silently substitutes semantics.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Thirty-seven collection routes expose page and per_page plus one root collection and meta.pagination.next_page.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Owns both paging arguments, walks exact page numbers at the documented maximum of 50, merges only the proven root collection, and records every automatic route.

audit_findings_folded.finding: GET /actions no longer lists arbitrary actions and now requires one or more id query values.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserves query.id as a required repeated exact-integer array, does not paginate the route, and bundles no misleading all-actions inventory workflow.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The API uses repeated array query keys and many integer or int64 identifiers, while JSON schemas do not bound every numeric response field.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Serializes arrays as repeated query parameters, exposes integer parameters as exact decimal strings, sends JSON bodies verbatim, and parses every JSON response with unsafe integers preserved as strings.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Ten successful DELETE operations return 204 with no content rather than a JSON object.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declares no response schema and no response_json parser for those exact routes while preserving JSON schemas and lossless parsing on the other 167 active operations.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The July 2026 changelog announces that four change_dns_ptr bodies must include dns_ptr as a string or null starting 30 September 2026, while the current schema still leaves it optional.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Adds the future requirement to each affected operation description and fixture; body_raw stays lossless and the provider remains the fail-closed structural validator until the OpenAPI itself changes.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Hetzner documentation also covers Storage Boxes on api.hetzner.com, S3-compatible Object Storage, and link-local server metadata.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps this family exact-origin Cloud API only; separate hosts and transports require separate packs instead of caller-controlled origins or undocumented capability widening.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Certificates, SSH keys, addressing, topology, pricing, and action records are private project data even when they do not contain reusable secrets.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps all reads uncached and approval-free, labels every response sensitive, and bundles only seventeen explicit non-chat inventory workflows with completeness disclosure.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Servers, networks, volumes, zones, and actions resemble entities but are infrastructure control-plane records rather than user-work tasks, notes, or projects.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declares no work_entity_sources and records the semantic rejection in durable audit evidence instead of manufacturing a misleading canonical projection.
